newsitem.title: ROMANIA: ROMANIA AZOMURES HAD BETTER 1996 RESULTS.
newsitem.headline: ROMANIA AZOMURES HAD BETTER 1996 RESULTS.

text.p: Romanian listed fertiliser maker Azomures saw better performance last year, with its turnover rising by 72.2 percent on 1995 to 574 billion lei and net profit going up five times to 72.63 billion lei.
A company report to the Bucharest stock exchange showed on Friday better management and favourable export conditions had led to the improved results last year.

"The development of exports in 1996 was influenced by the relatively high prices on the external market," the report said, pointing out that last year's exports accounted for 61 percent of the company's overall fertiliser output of 1.18 million tonnes.

The report also said Azomures had increased its capital in 1996 to 209.4 billion lei from 168.5 billion after adding terrain to its capital base and following a merger with a local hothouse. The nominal value of an Azomures share is 1,000 lei.
Azomures was included in a mass privatisation programme launched late in 1995 under which a 49 percent stake went on offer against privatisation vouchers and coupons.
In February, the company's main shareholder, the State Ownership Fund, sold 51 percent to the Romanian trading company Eurotrading. That stake has yet to be transferred.
The company is one of the most actively traded stock on the bourse's first tier. At the latest trading session on Friday, its price was unchanged at 3,700. ($=7,089 lei)
